title: How to Prepare for an Interview

vocabulary.meaning_en: a formal meeting where a company asks you questions to decide if it will give you a job
vocabulary.example: I have a job interview at ten o'clock tomorrow.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person whose job is to sell a company's products
vocabulary.example: She works as a sales executive for a food company.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a job in a company (formal)
vocabulary.example: They have an open position in the sales team.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the person in charge of a team or a business
vocabulary.example: The manager wants to see you now.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a document that lists your education and work experience
vocabulary.example: Please send your CV by email.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the certificates and skills you have from study or training
vocabulary.example: Your qualifications look very good.

vocabulary.meaning_en: knowledge and skill you get from doing a job
vocabulary.note_ar: غير معدودة بهذا المعنى: some experience (ليس an experience)
vocabulary.note_en: Uncountable in this meaning: some experience.
vocabulary.example: Do you have any sales experience?

vocabulary.meaning_en: something that shows what you mean
vocabulary.example: Can you give me an example?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a planned set of activities to sell or promote something
vocabulary.example: We started a campaign to sell the new product.

vocabulary.meaning_en: help something become known and sold
vocabulary.example: We need to promote our new range.

vocabulary.meaning_en: succeed in doing something after hard work
vocabulary.example: She achieved a lot at university.

vocabulary.meaning_en: working well together with other people
vocabulary.example: Good team working is important in our office.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the person who looks after the money of a club or group
vocabulary.example: He was the treasurer of the student club.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the amount of money you have to spend on something
vocabulary.example: We had a very small budget.

vocabulary.meaning_en: good at planning things
vocabulary.example: We like organised people here.

vocabulary.meaning_en: being on time for work and finishing work on time
vocabulary.example: Good timekeeping is important to me.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the habit of arriving at the right time
vocabulary.example: Our company values punctuality.

vocabulary.meaning_en: sure of your own abilities
vocabulary.example: Be confident in your interview.

vocabulary.meaning_en: thinking you are better than other people
vocabulary.example: Be confident, but don't be arrogant.

vocabulary.meaning_en: show people your good skills so they choose you
vocabulary.example: In an interview you need to sell yourself.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a little worried or afraid
vocabulary.example: I always feel nervous before an interview.

vocabulary.meaning_en: formally ask for a job
vocabulary.example: Why did you apply for this job?

fine_lines.title: confident vs arrogant
fine_lines.explanation_ar: confident صفة إيجابية: واثق من قدراته. arrogant صفة سلبية: يظن أنه أفضل من الآخرين. في المقابلة كن واثقًا ولا تكن مغرورًا.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Confident is positive: you believe in your skills. Arrogant is negative: you think you are better than others.

examples.sentence: She was calm and confident in the interview.
He sounded arrogant when he talked about his colleagues.

fine_lines.title: job vs position
fine_lines.explanation_ar: المعنى متقارب، لكن position أكثر رسمية وتُستخدم في الإعلانات والمقابلات. job أعم وتُستخدم في الكلام اليومي.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean work you are paid for. "Position" is more formal and is used in adverts and interviews.

examples.sentence: We are interviewing for the position of sales executive.

expressions.phrase: A good example that comes to mind is...
expressions.meaning_en: Use it to start an example from your experience.
expressions.example: A good example that comes to mind is when I organised a team event.

expressions.meaning_en: Say something good you did, without boasting.
expressions.example: I'm particularly proud of how I helped new students.

expressions.meaning_en: You are always on time and finish work on time.
expressions.example: Timekeeping is important to me, so I always start early.

expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to welcome someone to a meeting.
expressions.example: Please sit down. Thanks for coming.

expressions.phrase: Could you give me an example of...?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنك أن تعطيني مثالًا على...؟
expressions.example: Could you give me an example of good teamwork?

expressions.phrase: I always try to complete my work on time.
expressions.meaning_ar: أحاول دائمًا أن أُنهي عملي في الوقت المحدد.
expressions.meaning_en: A good answer that shows you are reliable.
expressions.example: I always try to complete my work on time, even when I am busy.

grammar.title: Talking about yourself: "I'm + adverb + adjective + of"
grammar.explanation_ar: لكي تتحدث عن نفسك بإيجابية دون تفاخر، استخدم ظرفًا مثل particularly أو really قبل الصفة: I'm particularly proud of + اسم أو فعل بصيغة -ing. وبعد proud نستخدم حرف الجر of دائمًا.
grammar.explanation_en: To speak well about yourself without boasting, put an adverb before the adjective: I'm particularly proud of + noun or -ing. After "proud" always use "of".
examples: I'm particularly proud of my exam results.
I'm really proud of organising the event.
I'm particularly proud of how I managed the budget.

grammar.title: Past simple for examples from your experience
grammar.explanation_ar: عند إعطاء مثال من الماضي في المقابلة نستخدم الماضي البسيط: I worked, I organised, I was. الفعل المنتظم يضاف له -ed، وبعض الأفعال شاذة مثل was/had.
grammar.explanation_en: When you give an example from the past, use the past simple: I worked, I organised, I had. Regular verbs add -ed; some verbs are irregular (was, had).
examples: I worked in a shop for two years.
I was the treasurer of the club.
We had a small budget, so I made careful decisions.

questions.question: Which phrase is best for starting an example in an interview?
choices: A good example that comes to mind is...
questions.explanation_ar: A good example that comes to mind is... هي العبارة التي تعلّمناها لتقديم مثال.
questions.explanation_en: This is the phrase the episode teaches for giving an example.

questions.question: I'm particularly proud ___ my work at university.
What does "timekeeping" mean?
choices: being on time and finishing work on time
questions.explanation_en: It means being on time and finishing work on time.

questions.question: In an interview you should be confident but not ___.
questions.explanation_ar: المطلوب أن تكون واثقًا لا مغرورًا arrogant.

questions.question: A CV is...
choices: a list of your education and work experience
questions.explanation_en: A CV is a document about your education and work.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: I have many experiences in sales.
I have a lot of experience in sales.
I have an experience in sale.
I has a lot of experience in sales.
questions.explanation_ar: experience بمعنى الخبرة غير معدودة: a lot of experience.
questions.explanation_en: "Experience" (skill) is uncountable: a lot of experience.

questions.question: The person who looks after the money of a club is the ___.
questions.explanation_en: A treasurer looks after the money.

questions.question: "Sell yourself" in an interview means...
questions.explanation_ar: sell yourself تعني أن تُبرز مهاراتك.
questions.explanation_en: It means showing your good skills.

questions.question: Which word means the habit of arriving on time?
questions.explanation_en: Punctuality is arriving at the right time.

questions.question: At university I ___ the finances for the club.
questions.explanation_ar: نتحدث عن الماضي، فنستخدم الماضي البسيط organised.
questions.explanation_en: It is about the past, so use the past simple: organised.
